title: •Commander Nemet
caption: •Commander Nemet (V)
game_text: {pilot:1}. While piloting at a battleground system, your Force drains here may not be canceled. While piloting at a system with a ‘probe’ card, during your deploy phase (or if just forfeited), may be placed as a ‘probe’ card at any system.
lore: Logistics officer for the _Avenger_, member of the Line Branch of the Imperial Navy. Relays important scanner information to Captain Needa. Fiercely competitive.
copyright: TM & © 1997 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1997 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 1 / ABILITY 2, third box blank; deploy 2 / forfeit 3. Leading yellow DS pilot-power icon + '1.' → {pilot:1}. Curly single quotes ‘probe’ (twice). Icon column: pilot only. Imperial (Imperial disc). The wiki's default page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text; printed face = 'Commander Nemet (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px Dagobah-D-commandernemet.gif is the D-E1 errata face — downloaded to src/vs14/22-Dagobah-D-commandernemet.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan (350×490) is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected from scan: _Avenger_ italic (wiki plain). Copyright 1997 legible on the 745 face. Modern: V3-D-commandernemet.gif (745 px) is the PC's Virtual Set 3 Commander Nemet (V) (different text) — art backport only; VB2 -pre (350, this slip reissued) also exists, not downloaded.
